features.title: Setup enable / controller
features.native: Enable controls contribution; policy retained in scene
features.mcp: Read configuration; plans act on enrolled/owned setups only
features.qualification_or_extension: Explicit policy-3 controller creation/conversion contract; conversion must respect Edit bindings

features.title: Receiver and units / controller
features.native: Static flat/curved supported meshes for scatter/Brush; shared receiver defaults
features.mcp: Design enrollment: horizontal convex static site, restricted mesh/primitives
features.qualification_or_extension: Receiver capability card, topology/units fingerprint, bounded curved enrollment after host proof

features.title: Layer administration / controller
features.native: Create/copy/remove/name/enable/hide/order; ten total stored populations including sets
features.mcp: Existing plans create up to three owned independent layers; read ordered policy-3 owners
features.qualification_or_extension: Typed create/copy/remove/reorder with identity remapping, ownership and one transaction

features.title: Paint-set ownership / logical layer
features.native: Weighted sets share layer population/defaults; independent sources and coverage
features.mcp: Read effective values/paint status and procedural order; no set creation
features.qualification_or_extension: Explicit declared/inherited/effective values, stable set IDs and atomic parent/set plan

features.title: Source palette / set
features.native: Pick/remove/share models, groups, weights and metadata
features.mcp: Enroll up to three approved mesh assets; plan source weights/settings; read source configuration
features.qualification_or_extension: Broader qualified asset enrollment and capability restrictions; no arbitrary scene node IDs

features.title: Point/Empty source types / set
features.native: Point slots and intentional Empty choices; target mode rejects Empty
features.mcp: Inspection handles non-mesh/missing entries; design plans require mesh sources
features.qualification_or_extension: Typed source kinds and count semantics before remote creation

features.title: Model containers / global/layer/set
features.native: Rectangle-local XY pivot membership; global/inherited/own pools; parking preserves registration/settings
features.mcp: Read configured references/mode plus cached active/parked/missing/placeholder rows and membership revision when available. Stale row alignment is unavailable; no reconciliation or current-containment query. Bounded private Max 2027 reads were qualified in the 6 October Live runtime campaign.
features.qualification_or_extension: Cached active/parked/missing snapshot with membership revision; later scoped rectangle/pool authoring

features.title: Source transform/radius / set row
features.native: Source lift/scale/forward axis, radius and follow-scale; per-owner settings
features.mcp: Plan-2 typed source settings; policy-3 metadata inspection
features.qualification_or_extension: Policy-3 recipe authoring and normalized effective radius explanation

features.title: Population and seed / layer
features.native: Count or density, stable seed, weighted quota allocation
features.mcp: Plans use bounded count/seed; current configuration exposes more than plans can author
features.qualification_or_extension: Density/target semantics and total sample budget; no implicit quota per child

features.title: Candidate budget / accepted target / layer
features.native: Bounded attempt factor, rounds and cleanup-gap retries
features.mcp: Policy-3 recipe and last-published statistics read only
features.qualification_or_extension: Typed target/work admission and underfill acceptance after actual evaluation

features.title: Density texture / layer
features.native: Texture/UV density and inversion; qualified native invalidation paths
features.mcp: No map enrollment/write contract
features.qualification_or_extension: Bounded enrolled map references, revisions and supported evaluation; reject missing assets explicitly

features.title: Area include/exclude / layer
features.native: Supported scene splines/meshes; Area combines with Brush
features.mcp: Plan-2 enrolled convex include/exclude/protected regions and conservative masks
features.qualification_or_extension: General domain adapters and surface-bound references; no inferred world mask from an image

features.title: Analyzer Area/falloff / layer
features.native: Existing supported Analyzer references, curves and distances
features.mcp: No mutation; current plan geometry remains narrow
features.qualification_or_extension: Analysis capability/version, cached result status and separately qualified binding

features.title: Brush coverage / set
features.native: Static surface-bound Paint/Erase; radius, strength, softness, density; overlays
features.mcp: Read paint enabled/document/revision/count; no Brush authoring
features.qualification_or_extension: Typed target-bound stroke/field operations, capped samples/history and one Undo gesture

features.title: Brush history/reset / set
features.native: Edit, enable, delete strokes; Fill/Empty reset histories; rebinding guard
features.mcp: No mutation or arbitrary document import
features.qualification_or_extension: Explicit replace/append/reset semantics, stale topology denial, rollback and persistence tests

features.title: Background composition / set
features.native: Outside coverage, Between plants, both/off; earlier sibling references
features.mcp: Policy-3 recipe read only
features.qualification_or_extension: Separate typed operations/fields; validate order/domain/spacing without silent fallback

features.title: Random/cluster assignment / layer
features.native: Policy 3 supports Random/Clusters and source grouping
features.mcp: Existing plan writes random weighted sources; no cluster authoring
features.qualification_or_extension: Qualified typed cluster parameters; preserve deterministic identities

features.title: Line/Analyzer assignment / layer
features.native: Supported legacy policies; not policy-3 assignment
features.mcp: Unavailable for mutation
features.qualification_or_extension: Preserve honest policy restriction; do not offer it in a procedural plan until implemented

features.title: Rotation/scale/movement / layer
features.native: XYZ/whole scale/rotation, normal alignment, projected movement and resets
features.mcp: Plan 1 basic scale/yaw; plan 2 XYZ scale, XY tilt/projected movement; not every native axis/mode
features.qualification_or_extension: Policy-3 parity, effective units/ranges and protected-binding effects

features.title: Three collision scopes / set/layer/pair
features.native: Independent self, sibling and layer rules; XY/3D; radius factor/gap
features.mcp: Plan 2 older shared collision/pair settings; read policy-3 rules
features.qualification_or_extension: Policy-3 schema with ordered owners, inherited self rule, explicit pair overrides and final-radius checks

features.title: Instance Edit/radius / output identity
features.native: Move/clone/delete protections and selected-instance world radius/multiplier
features.mcp: No mutation; read stored procedural radius overrides
features.qualification_or_extension: Snapshot-bound typed edits; define cross-generation correspondence or reject stale identities

features.title: Cleanup / layer union
features.native: Final neighbor/island cleanup, protected reservations, bounded retry
features.mcp: Typed older-plan cleanup; procedural diagnostics read
features.qualification_or_extension: Policy-3 parity and disjoint candidate/instance accounting

features.title: Relax / legacy layer
features.native: Supported older unpainted paths; incompatible Brush/shared/procedural paths paused
features.mcp: Unavailable
features.qualification_or_extension: Qualify movement/eligibility semantics before enabling; no misleading replacement with another algorithm

features.title: Manual/Live and Update / setup
features.native: Manual keeps complete publication until Update; Live responds to relevant edits
features.mcp: Existing plan display update mode; read cached result; no general policy-3 Update tool
features.qualification_or_extension: Distinguish authored commit, evaluate, pending recipe and published result explicitly

features.title: Preview / setup/layer
features.native: Retained Point Cloud/Mesh; Proxy/centres; display budgets, colours and radius helpers
features.mcp: Plan-2 display subset; cached diagnostic counters and bounded viewport capture
features.qualification_or_extension: Read-only current diagnostics; later display-only write with zero resampling contract

features.title: UI navigation / editor
features.native: One selected layer in sixteen native Modify sections; optional popup with six topics. Warm retarget binds the current owner. Browsing preserves publications and retained buffers; pointer/DPI latency is a separate qualification.
features.mcp: No remote UI clicking API
features.qualification_or_extension: Feature help should map to artist location; UI browsing must not become a calculation action

features.title: Statistics / set/controller
features.native: Cached accepted/rejected/attempt/shortfall/protected/error/epoch data
features.mcp: Diagnostics/configuration; process totals distinct from per-controller data
features.qualification_or_extension: Reason codes, field freshness/availability and optional bounded conflict samples

features.title: Renderer / output
features.native: PFlow exact-output adapter; successful production examples; open IR restart issue
features.mcp: No render execution tool; capture is viewport only
features.qualification_or_extension: Qualified camera/profile enrollment, render jobs and correlated completion/failure receipts

features.title: Bake/clear / owned output
features.native: Local Bake and clear-owned-output paths
features.mcp: No mutation
features.qualification_or_extension: Destructive scope, renderer/source fidelity, size cap, undo and failure-before-cleanup checks

features.title: Save/load/Undo / scene
features.native: Authored state persists; caches reconstruct; binding/unit restrictions
features.mcp: Scoped local recovery, journal and own top-Undo checks; no arbitrary scene-save command
features.qualification_or_extension: Explicit future snapshot/recovery operations; no remote overwrite of arbitrary files

features.title: Export / published generation
features.native: Exact local placements; native stable identity semantics
features.mcp: Legacy owned records remain supported. MCP 1.2 get_publication/read_publication_page reads policy-3 cached transforms, effective radii, stable IDs and compact metadata. Bounded private Max 2027 paging was qualified in the 6 October Live runtime campaign. Full reconstructable recipe/asset export remains unavailable.
features.qualification_or_extension: Immutable policy-3 publication export with recipe, sources, radii, epoch, digest and bounded paging/artifacts

features.title: Diagnostics recording / session
features.native: Bounded process-wide native event recorder. Scatter Modify > Diagnostics starts/stops/exports a local paged bundle without MCP; Automation retains its own canonical report format. Off by default; no polling, automatic upload or training eligibility.
features.mcp: MCP 1.2 reads explicitly shared diagnostic event pages. Local controls own recording and file export. Bounded sharing and host lifecycle were qualified in the 6 October Live runtime campaign; no remote start, stop, grant or file write. A full causal archive is future work.
features.qualification_or_extension: Qualify the new bounded page and local-sharing boundary, then the full causal session/archive specification

features.title: Licensing / product
features.native: Default-off native/local lab foundation, incomplete commercial boundary
features.mcp: No licensing-administration authority or production enforcement implied
features.qualification_or_extension: Apply operation policy consistently across UI/API once qualified; redact grants/keys from diagnostics

features.title: References/style/learning / companion
features.native: Research and record contracts only
features.mcp: No training/inference tools or automatic collection
features.qualification_or_extension: Profile/recipe pilot, explicit comparisons, dataset eligibility and held-out evaluation
